title: Two Different Jobs
setting: A pretty little cafe with small tables and a big window.

characters.name: Hana
characters.look: Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer)

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt)

sentences.en: Hana and Sara have lunch in a pretty cafe.
sentences.zh: 哈娜和萨拉在一家漂亮的咖啡馆吃午饭。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer) and Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) sit at a small table in a pretty cafe with flowers in the window.

sentences.en: A waiter brings them two cups of tea.
sentences.zh: 一位男服务员给他们端来两杯茶。
sentences.scene_prompt: A young waiter in a black apron puts two cups of tea in front of Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer) and Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt).

sentences.en: Hana works in an office for a big company.
sentences.zh: 哈娜在一家大公司的办公室上班。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer) sits at a desk with a computer in a busy office of a big company.

sentences.en: Her job is boring, with too many meetings.
sentences.zh: 她的工作很无聊，会议太多。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer) yawns at a long meeting table with people in suits.

sentences.en: Sara is a farmer, and she loves her farm.
sentences.zh: 萨拉是一位农场主，她很爱她的农场。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt), now in rubber boots, stands smiling in a green field with cows and a red barn.

sentences.en: She has a business selling eggs and milk.
sentences.zh: 她做生意，卖鸡蛋和牛奶。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt), now in rubber boots, sells eggs and bottles of milk to customers at a little farm stall.

sentences.en: Her small team of workers helps her every day.
sentences.zh: 她的小团队里的工人们每天都帮她干活。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt), now in rubber boots, and a few farm workers carry baskets of eggs together.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Sara and her workers carrying eggs together; 'every day' can't be shown.

sentences.en: The young waitress wants to visit Sara's farm.
sentences.zh: 年轻的女服务员很想去萨拉的农场看看。
sentences.scene_prompt: In the cafe, a young waitress looks excitedly at a photo of cows that Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) shows her, while Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer) smiles.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the waitress excited by a photo of the farm; 'wants to visit' can only be guessed.
